title: SplatAtlas
source: Paper Appendix A.1, Table 4: 30 approved methods on all 31 shared scenes; full held-out native RGB evaluation of the recorded checkpoints.
aggregation: Scene-equal dataset means. Each scene uses its complete held-out RGB image set. LPIPS uses VGG. Checkpoint stages and configuration repairs are retained in the scene records and method notes.

methods.name: 3DGS-MCMC
methods.note: Four T&T scenes use the completed SfM initialization repairs: auditorium, lighthouse, palace and temple.

methods.name: GHAP
methods.note: The evaluated GHAP configuration retains GMR at 15k with ratio 0.1.

methods.name: LightGaussian
methods.note: 10k checkpoints are used for stump, playground and truck; the other checkpoints are 30k.

methods.name: Mip-Splatting
methods.note: A 20k checkpoint is used for ballroom; the other checkpoints are 30k.

methods.name: Octree-GS
methods.note: 40k checkpoints are used for all scenes.

methods.name: RaDe-GS
methods.note: Bicycle, stump and treehill use the completed cap-5M configuration repairs.
